Package game.weather

Class OpenWeatherClient

java.lang.Object
game.weather.OpenWeatherClient
All Implemented Interfaces:
WeatherSource
public class OpenWeatherClient extends Object implements WeatherSource
Asks OpenWeatherMap for the real weather.

The API key is found by an ApiKeyLoader, so it is never written in the code. If there is no key, or a request fails or times out, the answer is empty and the game carries on without the weather. The reply is read by an OpenWeatherParser.

Sending the request is kept in fetch(URI), which a test can override to return a fixed reply, so no test needs the network.
